name: PayGate x402
description: Pay-per-call API marketplace on Arc mainnet. Sellers wrap HTTPS endpoints with x402 paywalls priced in USDC; Circle's Facilitator Service settles every call verify-then-settle; every settled fill is stamped on-chain for public verification.

skills.name: Browse PayGate endpoints
skills.description: List all 20 paid endpoints (market data, RWA, web extraction, infrastructure) with per-call USDC pricing.

skills.name: Pay for a call
skills.description: POST/GET any /api/x402/<slug> endpoint; unpaid returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge (x402 v2, exact scheme, EIP-3009 USDC on eip155:5042); sign and retry with Payment-Signature header.
examples: call crypto-prices for BTC and ETH

authentication.description: Payment is authentication: per-call USDC settlement via Circle Facilitator on eip155:5042. No API keys, no accounts.
